verdict.rationale: Vercel Agent is documented as an AI assistant built into Vercel. It works from dashboard chat, Slack, Investigations, and Code Review, and can investigate production issues, review code, reproduce issues in sandboxes, and take approved actions. That covers delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. missing for 10: general availability (it is public beta and limited to Pro/Enterprise teams), detailed documentation of which actions it can perform, independent or hands-on corroboration.
